title: Trace, untangled
summary: Header X's grammar with this layer's own band: a knot of disconnected tools untangles into one documented route raised above the market it starts and ends in; one packet runs it once and the buyer node latches red.
story: Opens on the job the homepage gave this layer — the machine that carries the story to buyers — and repositions it off ‘outbound’: a signal from the market steps up into one documented route (the four services in order), then steps back down to one buyer. The dimension measures exactly the raised run, so the two levels mean something. Its four flags are the four services the ledger below opens.

motion: entrance: the kit head choreography; registration marks at 600–780ms; the knot fades in at 900ms.

orchestrated moment (1.7–4.9s): the ten vertices untangle left to right over 1.5s (40ms stagger) into the two-level route; the route brightens, the two end names appear, the four flags register in route order, the dimension draws and its extension lines drop to the two steps; at 3.4s one packet runs Signal → The buyer once (1.5s) and the buyer node latches red. No loop.
